diagramDecision.consideration: Considered omitting a lone inter-paper edge. Retained one diagram because the two inputs to C converge and because juxtaposing B prevents an invalid substitution of a linear-image bound for entire-group abelianity.
diagramDecision.diagramVsTable: The diagram shows convergence and scope distinction; the two-row table records premise vs background, hypotheses and use pages. No separate per-edge figures or fixed categories.
